findings.evidence: dom-1440 records the h1 with empty text; bodyText shows the rotating word split into one span per letter ('to c r e a t e'), while the tile shows 'to build'. Screen readers may read single letters or a word that changes under them.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: the page's only h1 has no stable text. Nearest curated card A11-007.

findings.where: hero stat marquee and integrations marquee
findings.evidence: The stat row is duplicated in the DOM ('20 days ... NETFLIX' twice) and cut off at both edges in tiles 1440-00 and 375-00; the integrations list is repeated four times: both are infinite scrolling marquees with no pause control.
findings.after: Add a visible pause button (aria-pressed) and stop the animation under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce); render the second copy with aria-hidden="true".
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: moving content lasting more than 5 seconds needs a pause mechanism; the duplicate copy is also read twice (1.3.1).

findings.evidence: bodyText shows the code split into one element per character ('i m p o r t { o p t i m u s }', 'n p m i n s t a l l'), a typing animation; assistive tech and copy-paste receive fragmented characters.
findings.before: Per-character spans inside the code block
findings.after: Put the full code string in <pre><code> and animate a visual overlay marked aria-hidden="true", or drop the typing effect.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence. Nearest curated card A11-006.

findings.evidence: The grey particle-glyph sphere runs through the h1 'platform', the sub-line 'start innovating.' and behind the 'Start free trial' button; at 375 glyphs sit directly behind the body copy.
findings.after: Keep the field out of the text column (mask it to the right half) or lower it behind a solid panel.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): busy backgrounds reduce legibility even where the average ratio passes; verify against real pixels.

findings.evidence: Verified sweep hit: inactive steps 'Build your workflow' and 'Ship to production' and their copy are drawn at about 24% opacity on near-black; their content is only readable when the auto-advancing step reaches them.
findings.after: Keep inactive steps at full text colour and mark the active one with weight or a bar; or give each step a button with aria-expanded.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast and 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide (auto-advancing progress bar under step I).

findings.evidence: A switch with text 'Monthly' and 'Annual' beside it; dom-1440 has an unnamed <button> just before the 'Starter' heading. The labels are not inside the control.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 2.5.3 Label in Name.

strengths: Landmarks present (header, nav, main, footer), lang=en, visible focus order follows the reading order for the first 15 stops.
not_investigated: Mobile menu and testimonial carousel keyboard behaviour: no live keyboard test.
